name: Sleeping Shaq
look: White space on the left for captions beside two photos of Shaquille O'Neal. Top: he sleeps peacefully on a white pillow, captioned "i sleep." Bottom: a deep-fried, oversharpened close-up shows him wide awake with glowing lens-flare eyes, captioned "real shit."
use: Contrasts what someone ignores with what instantly grabs their attention. The top-left caption is something important or boring that Shaq sleeps through, and the bottom-left caption is the oddly specific thing that wakes him up wide-eyed.
slots: left of the top photo: what he sleeps through
left of the bottom photo: what wakes him up
examples: Someone quietly opening a bag of chips two rooms away
Researching the history of spoons at 2 a.m.
